intent: An evaluation never calls a trial answer wrong or within its limit on the strength of a part the runtime cut off.
observable_outcome: A rule check on a run whose final output was cut records undetermined with the reason that the output was cut off at N characters, instead of failed for a missing value or passed for a length within the limit.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A value a rule check cannot find in a cut final output is undetermined, and the reason names the character count the output was cut at.
A cut final output within a length limit is undetermined; a kept part already over the limit fails, and a value found in the kept part passes.
The judge request reports the final output as cut when the runtime cut it, so a judge pass on it is not recorded.
